worldcombat.skill.saltcure.summary: Slap a crust of coarse salt onto the target: the hit deals physical damage, then the salt crust stings away a share of the target's maximum health every few seconds. Steel and Water types, soaked bodies and metal-clad ones hurt more.
worldcombat.skill.saltcure.use.2: Force the enemy to spend time curing status
worldcombat.skill.saltcure.description.0: The hit deals %1$s physical damage and coats the target in a salt crust.
worldcombat.skill.saltcure.description.1: The crust lasts %1$s, stinging away %2$s of the target's maximum health every %3$s; Steel/Water, soaked and metal-clad bodies take double. It stays until cleansed or expired, after which it no longer stings.
worldcombat.skill.saltcure.description.2: Throw range %1$s blocks, salt speed %2$s, hit radius %3$s. The salt is a thrown projectile; if it is stopped or misses in flight it deals no damage and leaves no crust.
worldcombat.skill.saltcure.preference.br: On: each sting x1.35 and interval x0.85, but the crust lasts only 70% as long and the cooldown is 8 ticks longer. Off: a longer crust that grinds by time.
worldcombat.skill.saltcure.preference.ai: The companion only considers Salt Cure while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion prioritizes Steel/Water or soaked targets (double sting); off sorts by health instead.
When on, the companion may leave its post to salt a target under a Hold order.
